Who said that the [[Coruscant (Dark) (Coruscant){{!}}Coruscant]] expansion focused only on [[Coruscant (Dark) (Coruscant){{!}}Coruscant]]? Here's that (in)famous face from outer space who loves it when you podrace, Gardulla the Hutt. Not only is she a fixture in any wretched hive of scum and villainy, but Gardulla can fit into any deck that wants to outlast the other guy. And who doesn't want to outlast the other guy?

To start with, Gardulla has excellent stats, with 3 power, 3 ability, and a sizable 5 forfeit value at only 3 Force. She's also a gambler (all the better to play Sabacc with), a gangster (she loves [[Jabba's Influence]]), and &#150; yes &#150; a Hutt (I hear she has a [[Desilijic Tattoo]] somewhere...).

But, like any character, the real meat is in the game text: Gardulla is the ultimate spectator for Podracing decks. For one thing, when you win the Podrace, Gardulla can cash in your chips for you, taking any or all of your retrieved Force into your hand. If you've been losing some good stuff from the top of your deck that you'd prefer not to risk back in the Reserve, Gardulla is your ticket to instant gratification.

In addition, Gardulla adds to the ranks of "wagering" characters in SWCCG... only Gardulla likes to fix the odds in her favor. Once during your control phase, you can force your opponent to draw destiny. If it's greater than 2 (and so many destiny draws are these days), you can retrieve 1 Force, simple as that. Best of all, she can gamble anywhere, any time, so you can park her at the Podrace Arena, use her to weed out those high race destinies your opponent may have stacked at the top of his deck, get a peek at what he's playing with, and retrieve Force at the same time! There's no easier way to take advantage of a destiny-loving opponent. Hedging your bets, indeed!

Combos:

If you win, you're looking at your choice of 11 cards to recycle into your hand.

Look at your opponent's Reserve deck and set up that bet!

Two gambling freaks who get freaky with each other. Gardulla can get rid of a high destiny before Barquin's wager, and Barquin gains an extra +1 bonus to his wager while Gardulla's around. They even draw battle destiny together!
